items.ti: 나는 다른 사람에 대해 모르지만 매우 저명한 사람들로 가득 찬 테이블에서 의무적인 시간 변경 직후 밤에 집에 가는 것이 싫다고 말했습니다. 그리고 그것은 DARK입니다. 우울해요! 신사 중 한 명은 “저는 어둠 속에서 집에 가는 것이 정말 싫습니다”라고 말했습니다. 또한 Crime Ridden Blue States에서는 어둠 속에서 집으로 걸어가는 것이 훨씬 더 위험합니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: I don’t know about anyone else, but a table full of very distinguished people just told me that they HATE, immediately after a mandatory time change, going home at night – and it’s DARK. It’s depressing! One of the gentleman stated that, “I just hate going home in darkness.” It’s also, in Crime Ridden Blue States, a lot more dangerous to be walking home in the dark! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: Tom Cotton이 아칸소를 최우선으로 생각한다면 그는 그들에게 일광 시간을 추가로 제공할 것이며, 더 중요한 것은 그들이 집, 농장, 작업장 및 기타 모든 곳을 1년에 두 번씩 시계를 바꾸는 것을 잊어버리고 돌아다닐 필요가 없다는 것입니다. 그것은 정말로 Arkansas를 최우선으로 생각하는 것입니다. 그리고 저는 Tom과 달리 Great State에서 거의 40점 차이로 세 번이나 우승했기 때문에 알고 있습니다! 또한 이는 공화당, 특히 우리가 WINS를 사용할 수 있는 공화당 상원에 매우 좋고 쉬운 승리가 될 것입니다! 하원은 오래 전에 매우 초당적인 투표(308 대 117)를 통해 “햇빛 보호법”을 승인했습니다. 이 법안은 모든 것이 죽는 곳인 상원에서 Tom Cotton에 의해 몇 달 동안 보류되었습니다! — 그리고 "자아" 외에 무엇을 위해서요? 과거에 폐지된 이유는 오래전부터 일부 의원과 상원의원이 사용했기 때문이다.
items.ti_en: If Tom Cotton were putting Arkansas first, he would give them an extra hour of daylight and, more importantly, they wouldn’t have to run all over their houses, farms, work places, and everywhere else, twice a year, having to change their Clocks, and often forgetting to do so. That is really putting Arkansas FIRST, and I know, because, unlike Tom, I won that Great State, three times, and by almost 40 points! Additionally, it would be a very nice and easy WIN for the Republican Party, in particular, the Republican Senate, a place where we could use some WINS! The House approved, long ago, “The Sunshine Protection Act,” by a very Bipartisan Vote, 308 to 117. It has been held up in the Senate, a place where things go to die, by Tom Cotton, for months! — And for what, other than “ego?” The reason that it was terminated in the past was that certain Congressmen and Senators, from long ago, used it as a “negotiating chip” for far more important Legislation — And they got plenty! Everybody loved it, but it was given up in order to get bigger, better, and more consequential “things.” Give the Republican Party a Senatorial WIN, for a change! Thank you to Speaker of the House Mike Johnson, and all Members of the House of Representatives, both Republican and Democrat, who so overwhelmingly approved “The No More Ridiculous Changing of Your Clocks Act,” and who so strongly want their “SUN” in the afternoon, rather than the early morning — Loved by Farmers, Sportsman, and Sports (Copy of PGA TOUR letter below!). Daylight Saving Time is 65-35 in the Polls but, why wouldn’t it be — Who wouldn’t want more “SUN” in the afternoon than in the morning? It’s even been proven to be better in stopping CRIME, something of which I have done an Historic job because, CRIMINALS DON’T LIKE WORKING IN THE LIGHT. Not wanting to change your many Clocks, including for Church Steeples and Municipal Buildings is, however, a 100% issue. TAKE THE WIN TOM, JUST TAKE THE WIN! YOU NEED IT, AND SO DOES OUR BELOVED REPUBLICAN PARTY! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: 내 친구인 아칸소의 톰 코튼(Tom Cotton)은 매우 중요한 법안을 들고 있습니다. 그 법안은 "일광 보호법" 또는 "우리는 1년에 두 번 시계를 바꾸고 싶지 않습니다."라고 합니다. 어떤 이유에서인지 Tom은 법안을 중단하려고 하는데 상원에서는 매우 쉽게 할 수 있습니다. 단 한 번만 하면 됩니다! 초당적 방식으로 압도적으로 통과되어야 합니다. 따라서 제가 좋아하는 주인 아칸소 주의 모든 사람들은 3번 승리했고 마지막에는 34점 차이로 승리했습니다. Tom에게 "끝내세요!"라고 말하세요. 모두가 높이 평가할 것입니다. 일년에 두 번씩 시계를 거꾸로 돌리면서 이곳 저곳을 뛰어다니며 소중한 시간을 보내고 싶은 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 이른 아침보다 오후에 햇빛을 받는 것이 더 좋습니다! 예를 들어 PGA TOUR에서는 토너먼트를 마치려면 오후에 햇빛이 더 많이 필요합니다. 마찬가지로, 일반 골퍼, 테니스 선수, 사냥꾼, 그리고 아마도 가장 중요한 것은 더 많은 일광을 즐기거나 게임을 즐기기를 원하는 농부일 것입니다.
items.ti_en: Everybody in Arkansas, Tom Cotton, a friend of mine, is holding up a very important Bill. It’s called, “The Sunshine Protection Act” or, “We Don’t Want to Change Our Clocks Twice a Year Act.” For some reason, Tom is stopping the Bill and, in the Senate, it’s very easy to do, it only takes one! It should pass overwhelmingly, in a Bipartisan fashion. So, everyone in Arkansas, a State I love, and won 3 times, the last by by 34 points, tell Tom to, GET IT DONE! It will be appreciated by all. Nobody wants to spend their precious time running all over the place, turning Clocks back twice a year and, having sunshine in the afternoon is better than early in the morning! The PGA TOUR, as an example, needs more Daylight in the afternoon in order to finish their Tournaments. Likewise, regular Golfers, Tennis Players, Hunters and, perhaps most importantly, Farmers who want more Daylight to play or work. See letter from Brian Rolapp, CEO of the PGA TOUR below. 65% PLUS want more sun in the afternoon, Daylight Saving Time (The way it is now!), but 100% don’t want to change their Clocks twice a year. They want to, as they say, “LOCK THE CLOCK!” Who doesn’t? It’s very expensive for our Nation where you have high and dangerous steeples to reach, like on churches and municipal buildings. Almost everybody wants “The Sunshine Protection Act” to pass, except for Tom Cotton. To the Great People of Arkansas, please let your Senator know it would be a GREAT Bipartisan WIN for the United States Senate, and for America, itself. Call Tom on his cellphone at, 479-453-0533, and let him know. “The Sunshine Protection Act” was passed in the House by a Vote of 308 to 117. HAVE THE SENATE VOTE, NOW! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
